name: Jobs by Location (Donut Chart)
description: Renders a donut chart of job counts per location from a set of parsed jobs, for the analytics section. Groups by ParsedJob.location, sorts descending, and caps to the top 8 locations (grouping the rest into "Other") with a legend. Computes its own SVG arc geometry with d3-shape's pie/arc generators — no browser DOM or canvas required.
author: jsrothwell
